label: D2 surprise: chose a2 but landed in S1 (rare), while policy still strongly favors a2
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), almost exclusively when the agent chose a2 and the state input is S1, i.e. a rare transition after a2 (in_action==2 holds 99.9% of mass, in_state==S1 97.8%). It does not fire on a1 trials (28 activations total) and only weakly on a2->S2 common (2% of mass). The plain behavioral predicate D2 & a2 & S1 gets mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.53; among a2->S1R steps it fires when the agent is confident in a2: adding prev_reward==1 gives P 0.70 / R 0.73 / mass 0.87 (prev_reward==0 cases are weak or silent, top two quartiles are almost all prev_reward==1), and conditioning on the model policy logit at that step (choice < -6, strong a2 preference) gives dev P 0.74 / R 0.86 / F1 0.79 / mass 0.97, which was recorded. Magnitude scales with the strength of the a2 preference / recent reward for a2; the top activations include a few rare a1->S1 trials right after a run of a2 choices. All variables are observed at D2 (no future variables).
